steps: Open a Peak Account online at the official promotion page https://kitsapcu.org/personal/checking/peak-account-promotion/?referralsource=330 between 2026-07-01 and 2026-12-16 using the 330-prefixed promo code.
Fund the account (minimum $25 to open) and enroll in e-statements.

Keep the account open and in good standing for at least 90 days; the $330 promotional credit is paid to the primary savings account within 30 business days of meeting the requirements.
